If necessary, transportation will be provided. Inspections will be made of those units that the displacees indicate a desire to rent or purchase to formally certify the adequacy and that they are D.S.S.
3. Displacees will be referred to local welfare and social service assistance agencies when it appears a need for such services.
4. Contact with each displacee will be made at least weekly during which various leads or referrals will be offered.

Visitations will be geared to the complexity, the specific needs and the level of availability and will be repeated until the housing responsibilities are discharged completely and fully in compliance with the spirit of the program.
5. The mobile relocation office will be utilized in the project area if the need arises, particularly if it is found that people desire additional contact with relocation personnel beyond the contacts mentioned in Item 4 above.
6. Assistance will be offered to complete claims for moving and supplemental payments for which each displacee may be eligible.
